evidence: DEFINING BEHAVIOUR GRADED: the public product is a shared pipeline board plus staff-candidate conversations that stay correct while several people act (instruction.md:1-9). Functional judge.toml grades it directly: hro_move_one_stage (w1.5), hro_reorder (1.5), hro_interview_full (1.5), hro_stale_refused (2.5, 409 + who changed it), hro_bulk_move/hro_bulk_all_or_none/hro_undo_restores/hro_undo_conflict, hro_live_board (2.5), hro_msg_exchange (1.5), hro_unread_counts (2), hro_seen (1.5), hro_candidate_private (2.5); polish grades hro_pol_live_board/hro_pol_live_thread (3 each). SERVER-BACKED (not just same-origin): constraints gate hro_gate_shared (gates/constraints/judge.toml:36) requires UI-created job+card to be read by the Observer in a new independent browser context and says 'a static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'; prompt.md:9 says 'A reload or a second tab of the same context is not independent.' Functional repeats it as the global gate (functional/prompt.md:11-13) and many rows re-read results in Mei Lin's / Aud's independent context (hro_arrive_bottom, hro_reorder, hro_bulk_move, hro_undo_restores, hro_activity). Per-person unread/seen state is read across independent sessions (U protocol, hro_unread_counts 'shared between people' fails; hro_seen cross-user). SURVIVES RESTART / RE-AUTH: brief requires 'keep new work across restarts' (instruction.md:15), order 'survives a reload, a fresh sign-in and a restart' (hireops_rules.md:59), 'Restarting the process over the same database file keeps all data, and seeding never duplicates records' (integration.md:8-9). hro_restart (functional/judge.toml:411-417, protocol D prompt.md:51) records jobs, per-stage order, notes, messages, per-conversation unread counts, activity and the seeded Platform Engineer order/note (pre-read in Z, prompt.md:25), calls restart_app once, signs in again and requires all unchanged and 'the starting data is not loaded again'; 'A reload is not a restart; if restart_app reports an error or cannot be called, hro_restart is 0.' restart_app (tools/restart_mcp.py, template-identical) relaunches the same app copy on the same DB_PATH (test.sh:127-193, template-identical). DRAFT DURABILITY (browser-scoped state the brief requires to survive reload and re-auth, instruction.md:7, hireops_rules.md:106,168-175): hro_drafts (functional) covers switch/Board/reload and per-conversation separation; hro_pol_session_resume (polish/judge.toml:74-80) ends the session from a second tab, requires a sign-in prompt with nothing sent, resumed reply sends after signing in as the same person, Mei sees neither Rafael's reply nor note draft, and Rafael's drafts return after Mei's visit; it does not mandate where drafts live ('Where drafts are kept is yours'), so server- or localStorage-backed drafts both conform. Note-draft survival across sign-out is in the same row; note-draft under live update in hro_pol_live_board. GOLDEN: SQLite at DB_PATH, seeded once (src/db.js:3,9,19-21); drafts in per-person-keyed localStorage (public/js/app.js:38-42, threads.js:112,124,182,196). Scripted golden run (raw-evidence-index, hashes verified, sources match frozen bytes) records passed=true for 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages, unread counts and activity without reseeding; live updates resume' (workspace.cjs:511-522 kills the process with SIGTERM and relaunches on the same DB, deep-compares applications/activity/unread) and for 'session ended mid-draft: sign-in prompt, nothing sent, same person resumes and sends; another person sees no draft'. WEAK-APP PROBES: (a) localStorage-only/browser-only app: fails hro_gate_shared (independent context) -> zero. (b) Server-memory app with no SQLite: passes gates and most rows but hro_restart=0 (loses duplicated/lost data) - durability is proven; its low mass (1.5 of 59.5 functional weight, ~1.5% of total reward) is a discrimination/ranking concern for rows 40/42, not a missing proof here. (c) App that reseeds on boot (wipes or duplicates): own jobs vanish or seeded Platform Engineer cards duplicate -> hro_restart=0. (d) Drafts kept in server memory keyed by session: session_resume fails after sign-out -> correctly graded per brief. CONFORMING ALTERNATIVES: server-stored drafts, sessionStorage-free localStorage drafts, polling/SSE/sockets, any route layout all pass; restart compares state relative to recorded pre-restart values, so no hidden seed-count assumption. RISK (true): no full configured judge run (claude-code + glm-5.3-flashx) has been measured for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'), so it is unmeasured whether the judge actually reaches protocol D within the 9000 s functional budget and successfully invokes restart_app, and whether hro_pol_session_resume's second-tab sign-out is executed as written. The scripted golden evidence is not judge execution. Design-level proof is present; runtime execution remains missing evidence.
